title: Finch Circle Registry Bonus — Registrant Courtesy Percent on Registry Credit Refunds (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
On a refund of registry credit left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, the registrant courtesy percent depends on two records: whether the registry type of the registry on which the credit was spent carries the Finch Circle registry bonus (Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry), and the tier of the registrant's active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program.

| Registry type carries the Finch Circle registry bonus | Active Finch Circle membership | Registrant courtesy percent |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Icon tier | Icon registrant courtesy percent, 10 percent |
| Yes | Platinum or Diamond tier | premier registrant courtesy percent, 5 percent |

Both parts of a row must hold. A registrant who meets neither row is outside this rule.

## Combinations

| Bonus on registry type | Tier | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Icon | 10 percent |
| Yes | Diamond | 5 percent |
| Yes | Gold | outside this rule |
| No | Icon | outside this rule |

## Hypothetical figure

On a registry credit shortfall of $45.00, 10 percent gives $4.50 and 5 percent gives $2.25, each rounded half up to the cent.
